name: Valkey Rebuild Protocol Implementation
description: Implement the rebuild-on-cold-start protocol: scan PGlite for non-terminal work items, repopulate Valkey Streams, Sorted Sets, and TTL keys. Must be fast (< 1s), idempotent, and derive all state from PGlite. This lane depends on the Durable ACK Binding lane — rebuild cannot be proven until the PGlite lifecycle schema is complete and every lifecycle transition writes to PGlite before touching Valkey.
